description: Without captureId: list recent capture runs for THIS project (other projects' captures are counted but hidden unless allProjects). With captureId: that run's summary metadata. Cite only the capture a command just returned as evidence. With journeys:true: the journeys you own and how each one's last check went — this repository's committed Flows, or, with `studio` + `token` (or $TAPP_STUDIO/$TAPP_TOKEN), the ones on your hosted Studio. That is how to answer "is everything still working?".

allProjects.description: Include other projects' and pre-provenance captures

captureId.description: Capture run id to summarise; omit to list

journeys.description: List journeys and their last result instead of captures

runPath.description: Absolute capture path override (must stay under captures/)

studio.description: journeys: a hosted Studio origin, e.g. https://app.runtapp.com (default $TAPP_STUDIO)

token.description: journeys: personal access token from the Studio's “Your coding agent” card (default $TAPP_TOKEN)

name: tapp_report
title: Evidence: recent runs, or one run's summary
